creator: Nathan Tabor
description: Consumer routes to existing published source or browser previews. Product links alone do not establish runtime service, regulatory approval or code efficacy.

stages.public-browser-preview: Public browser source or preview; feature completeness varies
stages.owner-local-browser: Owner-selected device or data; local storage and backup precautions apply
stages.developer-preview: Research/developer preview, no active security service

products.name: ONE — The Last App
products.details: Browse the creator's integrated applications, libraries, and locally available experiences.
limits: A launcher does not mean that every listed service is independently deployed or production-ready.
Individual modules have different storage, safety, and technical requirements.

products.name: ONE — Sealed Voice Box
products.task: Preserve and export your own original files
products.details: Choose files, protect them in a local encrypted archive, and explicitly export backups.
limits: No automatic access to other AI accounts, chats, email, or cloud history.
Passphrases are not recovered by the publisher. Back up your originals independently.
Browser-local files may disappear when site storage is cleared or devices fail.

products.name: ONE Library Mind
products.details: Browse a publicly released library of original drafts, source references, and language records.
limits: Not every planned book or translation is complete or independently reviewed.
Historical, religious, linguistic, and scientific claims require separate evidence.

products.name: 101-Action Chronicle
products.task: Explore and preserve your personal 101-action ledger
products.details: Use four original sections, an educational 101-gate game, and explicit source-preserving export.
limits: The author's private ledger is not included; import it only on a trusted device.
Source statements and allegations are not independent findings.
Keep the original text file as a separate backup.

products.name: Taborite Universal Language Matrix
products.task: Explore symbols, play the game, and read thirteen books
products.details: Use an original symbolic encoding interface, educational games, and thirteen short volumes.
limits: Creative glyph mappings and symbolic inversions are not automatically accepted linguistic history.
A reversible transformation is not secure encryption.

products.name: Six Dogs — KNICK to BONE
products.details: Follow KNICK → KNACK → PADDY → WHACK → DOG → BONE through an illustrated browser workbench.
limits: Creative and reflective framework, not clinical treatment or emotional diagnosis.
Illustrations do not prove live hardware, networking, or model inference.

products.name: Hall of Mirrors
products.task: Study mirror representations and passive security patterns
products.details: Explore the original source vocabulary, logical mirror IDs, and a non-executing pattern classifier.
limits: Not antivirus, verified malware detection, live quarantine, or a network honeypot.
Only use offline inspection on files you own and are authorized to review.
An absence of flagged patterns does not mean a file is safe.

products.name: Five Equal Guardians
products.details: Inspect the five preserved creator-designated guardian names and inert permission decisions.
limits: No network scan, actual protection, autonomous action, or malware removal occurs.
An on-page checkbox does not prove ownership or authenticate a user.

products.name: EYEPRINTS × HANDPRINTS
products.task: Organize private hand and iris image observations
products.details: Original hand-image research workbench with locally protected records and provenance.
limits: Not a medical device, biometric authentication product, or validated diagnosis.
Photographs can be highly sensitive. Use a trusted device, consent, and an offline backup.
Do not upload images of others without appropriate permission.

products.name: ONE — Health & Recovery
products.task: Organize personal health records and original notes
products.details: Locally encrypted original-file archive and independently labeled personal recovery notes.
limits: Not medical advice, treatment, emergency response, or a clinically validated device.
Do not delay qualified care because of this tool.
No publisher-side recovery of a forgotten vault password is promised.

products.name: Nathan AI — Anatomy A–Z
products.task: Explore the original anatomy and language atlas
products.details: Browse the creator's original A–Z conceptual anatomy and cross-language framework.
limits: Creative/symbolic models are not medical or anatomical diagnoses.
Ancient-language etymologies and scientific assertions need individual source verification.

products.name: Master Program Jobs Atlas
products.task: Find original software and its build tasks
products.details: Browse source references, 12 job categories, and local owner-reported review gates.
limits: 357 overlapping records are not 357 completed consumer applications.
Owner-reported checklists do not certify production, lawfulness, or independent security testing.
Private archives cannot be recovered merely from their filename.

products.name: NATHAN AI — SOVEREIGN DEFENDER
products.task: Review selected files, compare original hashes and rehearse safe ransomware response
products.details: Local-only antivirus-style file triage, SHA-256 original-fingerprint comparison and fictional ransomware-event review. Uses the preserved Hall of Mirrors classifier.
limits: Not installed antivirus, real malware removal, ransomware decryption, live protection or a security certification.
Select only files you own or are authorized to inspect; reports contain filenames and hashes that may be sensitive.
No indicator observed is not a safety clearance; keep separate offline backups and use a maintained security product for actual incidents.
